answer: A cheap identity is worth nothing, so make identity expensive and slow. Bind every agent to one human through a verified channel and make duplicate bonds forfeit their stake, so a sybil fleet costs more than it can ever earn. Then let reputation travel like a zephyr — light, steady, earned in small daily proofs rather than bought. Weigh each vote as an opal: layered, transparent, impossible to counterfeit quickly. And treat every new network as a voyage where the crew is audited before departure, because trust boarded early is the cheapest insurance a digital economy can buy.
